senses.en: referring to sexual matters in a rude, humorous way

example.en: The comedian's ribald jokes shocked some members of the audience.
example.zh: 这位喜剧演员的下流笑话让一些观众感到震惊。

senses.en: the year or place in which a wine was made

example.en: This wine is from an excellent vintage.
example.zh: 这款葡萄酒来自一个极好的年份。

senses.en: representing the high quality of a past period; classic

example.en: It was a vintage performance from the veteran player.
example.zh: 这是这位老将的经典表现。

senses.en: old and typically valuable or stylish

example.en: She collects vintage clothes from the 1960s.
example.zh: 她收藏二十世纪六十年代的复古服装。

senses.en: to push someone or something gently, often with the elbow

example.en: She nudged me to get my attention.
example.zh: 她轻推我以引起我的注意。

senses.en: to gently remind or urge someone to do something

example.en: The app nudges you to drink more water.
example.zh: 这款应用会提醒你多喝水。

senses.en: a light push, especially with the elbow

example.en: He gave me a nudge to wake me up.
example.zh: 他轻推我把我叫醒。

senses.en: to move or stir something violently

example.en: The boat's propeller churned the water into foam.
example.zh: 船的螺旋桨把水搅成了泡沫。

senses.en: to make butter by shaking or stirring cream

example.en: Farmers used to churn butter by hand.
example.zh: 农民过去常用手搅制黄油。

senses.en: a container for making butter

example.en: The old butter churn stood in the corner of the farmhouse.
example.zh: 老式黄油搅乳器立在农舍的角落里。

senses.en: extremely good, beautiful, or impressive; inspiring awe

example.en: The view from the mountain top was simply sublime.
example.zh: 山顶的景色简直壮丽无比。

senses.en: to change directly from a solid into a gas without melting first

example.en: Dry ice sublimes at room temperature.
example.zh: 干冰在室温下会升华。

senses.en: public disagreement or debate about something that many people have strong opinions on

example.en: The new law caused widespread controversy.
example.zh: 这项新法律引发了广泛的争议。

senses.en: happening or produced once every week

example.en: The team holds a weekly meeting.
example.zh: 团队每周举行一次会议。

senses.en: a magazine or newspaper published once a week

example.en: He writes for a local weekly.
example.zh: 他为一家当地周报撰稿。

senses.en: once every week

example.en: The magazine is published weekly.
example.zh: 这本杂志每周出版一次。

senses.en: to cause someone or something to be in a particular state
senses.zh: 使成为；使处于（某种状态）

example.en: The injury rendered him unable to walk.
example.zh: 伤势使他无法行走。

senses.en: to give, provide, or perform something such as help or a service

example.en: The volunteers rendered assistance to the affected families.
example.zh: 志愿者向受灾家庭提供了帮助。

senses.en: to represent or show something in a particular way, especially in art or writing

example.en: The artist rendered the landscape in soft colors.
example.zh: 这位艺术家用柔和的色彩描绘了这片风景。

senses.en: to start and be responsible for a task or project

example.en: She agreed to undertake the research project next year.
example.zh: 她同意明年承担这个研究项目。

senses.en: to promise or guarantee that something will be done

example.en: The company undertook to complete the repairs within a month.
example.zh: 公司承诺在一个月内完成维修。

senses.en: a number or amount shown in writing or speech

example.en: The final figure was higher than expected.
example.zh: 最终数字高于预期。

senses.en: a diagram or picture in a book or document

example.en: The figure below shows the main parts of the machine.
example.zh: 下面的图展示了机器的主要部件。

senses.en: to think or decide that something is probably true

example.en: I figure we should leave early.
example.zh: 我想我们应该早点离开。

senses.en: relating to the mind or thinking

example.en: Regular exercise can support mental well-being.
example.zh: 规律运动有助于维护心理健康。

senses.en: relating to a disorder of the mind

example.en: The clinic provides care for people with mental disorders.
example.zh: 该诊所为有精神障碍的人提供照护。

senses.en: a tall vertical pillar, especially one that supports a building

example.en: The museum has a row of stone columns at the entrance.
example.zh: 博物馆入口处有一排石柱。

senses.en: a regular article in a newspaper or magazine

example.en: She writes a weekly column about food.
example.zh: 她每周写一篇关于美食的专栏文章。

senses.en: a vertical block of text or numbers in a table or page

example.en: Add the numbers in the left column.
example.zh: 把左栏的数字加起来。

senses.en: the planning and organization of moving goods, supplies, or resources

example.en: Good logistics is essential for delivering products on time.
example.zh: 良好的物流对按时交付产品至关重要。

senses.en: the practical arrangements needed for an event or project

example.en: The logistics of the conference took months to organize.
example.zh: 会议的统筹安排花了几个月时间。

senses.en: a device with blades that spins to push a plane or ship forward

example.en: The boat's propeller spun rapidly as it left the harbor.
example.zh: 船离开港口时，螺旋桨飞速旋转。

senses.en: a machine with blades that turn in the wind, used to grind grain or pump water

example.en: The old windmill on the hill has stood there for two centuries.
example.zh: 山上那座老风车已经矗立了两个世纪。

senses.en: a modern wind turbine that generates electricity from wind
senses.zh: 风力发电机，风力涡轮机

example.en: The windmill supplies electricity to the farm.
example.zh: 这台风力发电机为农场供电。

senses.en: having a rough, harsh voice, often from shouting, illness, or emotion

example.en: His voice was hoarse after cheering at the game.
example.zh: 为比赛加油后，他的嗓子变得沙哑了。

senses.en: to abandon someone or something, especially when they need you

example.en: He would never forsake his family in hard times.
example.zh: 在困难时期他绝不会抛弃家人。

senses.en: a sailor, especially one who works on a ship

example.en: The experienced seaman guided the ship through the storm.
example.zh: 这位经验丰富的海员驾驶轮船穿过了风暴。

senses.en: a member of the lower ranks in a navy

example.en: He joined the navy and served as a seaman for two years.
example.zh: 他加入海军，当了两年水兵。

senses.en: excessive pride in oneself; vanity

example.en: His conceit made him ignore all advice.
example.zh: 他的自负使他听不进任何建议。

senses.en: an elaborate or far-fetched comparison or image, especially in poetry (literary)

example.en: The poet's conceit compares life to a fleeting shadow.
example.zh: 这位诗人的奇喻把人生比作转瞬即逝的影子。

senses.en: to devote oneself to a particular area of work or study (British spelling)

example.en: The firm specialises in commercial law.
example.zh: 这家律所专门从事商事法律业务。

senses.en: to adapt or become adapted to a specific function (biology)

example.en: These cells specialise early in development.
example.zh: 这些细胞在发育早期就发生特化。

senses.en: not correct or accurate

example.en: Your answer is wrong.
example.zh: 你的答案是错的。

senses.en: morally bad or unjust

example.en: It is wrong to lie.
example.zh: 说谎是不对的。

senses.en: incorrectly

example.en: I guessed wrong.
example.zh: 我猜错了。

senses.en: unjust or immoral behavior; an unfair act

example.en: We must right the wrongs of the past.
example.zh: 我们必须纠正过去的不义。

senses.en: in a higher position than; over

example.en: The lamp hangs above the table.
example.zh: 灯挂在桌子上方。

senses.en: more than a number or level

example.en: Temperatures rose above 30 degrees.
example.zh: 气温升到30度以上。

senses.en: in a higher place; earlier in a text

example.en: See the instructions above.
example.zh: 请参见上面的说明。

senses.en: mentioned earlier in the same text

example.en: The above rules apply to all users.
example.zh: 上述规则适用于所有用户。

senses.en: a person or company that creates software

example.en: She works as a software developer at a tech company.
example.zh: 她在一家科技公司做软件开发人员。

senses.en: a person or company that builds houses or buildings on land for sale

example.en: The developer plans to build 200 new apartments on this site.
example.zh: 开发商计划在这块地上建两百套新公寓。

senses.en: a chemical liquid used to develop photographic film

example.en: The photographer mixed the developer before processing the film.
example.zh: 摄影师在冲洗胶卷前调配了显影剂。

senses.en: the legal process of charging someone with a crime and bringing them to court

example.en: The prosecution of the case took nearly two years.
example.zh: 该案的起诉历时近两年。

senses.en: the lawyers representing the state in a criminal case

example.en: The prosecution presented strong evidence against the defendant.
example.zh: 控方向被告出示了有力的证据。

senses.en: a person whose beliefs, especially religious ones, go against accepted doctrine
senses.zh: 异端者；持非正统观点的人

example.en: In the Middle Ages, heretics were often severely punished.
example.zh: 在中世纪，异端者常受到严厉惩罚。

senses.en: open to or swept by strong winds
senses.zh: 暴露在风中的；受劲风侵袭的

example.en: The cottage stood on a windswept hill.
example.zh: 那座小屋坐落在一片狂风劲吹的山坡上。

senses.en: a person who does not fit in well with others or their surroundings

example.en: He always felt like a misfit at school.
example.zh: 他在学校总觉得格格不入。

senses.en: neat and smart in dress and appearance

example.en: A dapper old man in a grey suit greeted us.
example.zh: 一位穿灰色西装、衣着考究的老人迎接了我们。

senses.en: to openly disregard a rule or law
senses.zh: 公然违抗；无视（规则、法律）

example.en: The company flouted safety regulations for years.
example.zh: 这家公司多年来无视安全规定。

senses.en: a serious mental disorder affecting thought, emotion and perception of reality

example.en: Schizophrenia is treated with medication and therapy.
example.zh: 精神分裂症通过药物和心理治疗来处置。

senses.en: a person who cuts and styles people's hair

example.en: She booked an appointment with her hairdresser for Saturday.
example.zh: 她预约了周六与美发师见面。

senses.en: a male parent

example.en: My father taught me how to ride a bike.
example.zh: 我父亲教我骑自行车。

senses.en: to become the father of a child

example.en: He fathered two children before moving abroad.
example.zh: 他在移居国外前有了两个孩子。

senses.en: a person who starts or develops something important

example.en: He is often called the father of modern computing.
example.zh: 他常被称为现代计算之父。

senses.en: a title used for a priest

example.en: Father John will lead the service.
example.zh: 约翰神父将主持礼拜。

senses.en: the white liquid produced by mammals and drunk as food

example.en: She poured a glass of milk.
example.zh: 她倒了一杯牛奶。

senses.en: to take milk from an animal

example.en: He milks the cows every morning.
example.zh: 他每天早上给奶牛挤奶。

senses.en: to get as much advantage or money as possible from something

example.en: The company milked the project for all it was worth.
example.zh: 公司把这个项目榨取到了极致。

senses.en: a small object worn or carried that shows a person's job, rank, or membership

example.en: Please wear your employee badge at all times inside the building.
example.zh: 在大楼内请始终佩戴员工证。

senses.en: a sign of a particular quality or status

example.en: Long service became a badge of honor among the staff.
example.zh: 长期任职成了员工间荣誉的象征。

senses.en: to put a badge on someone or something
senses.zh: 给……佩戴徽章；用徽章标示

example.en: All visitors were badged before entering the facility.
example.zh: 所有访客进入设施前都配发了证件。

senses.en: goods that are bought and sold, especially in stores

example.en: The store sells a wide range of merchandise, from clothing to electronics.
example.zh: 这家商店出售从服装到电子产品的各类商品。

senses.en: to buy and sell goods for profit; to promote and sell products

example.en: The company licenses its cartoon characters and merchandises them worldwide.
example.zh: 这家公司将其卡通形象授权并在全球范围内进行商品化销售。

senses.en: a small gelatin container filled with medicine that you swallow

example.en: The doctor gave her capsules for the infection.
example.zh: 医生给她开了治疗感染的胶囊。

senses.en: a sealed compartment carrying people or things, e.g. in a spacecraft or submarine

example.en: The astronauts returned to Earth in the space capsule.
example.zh: 宇航员乘航天密封舱返回地球。

senses.en: a small case or container, or a short summary of something

example.en: The report gives a capsule summary of the project.
example.zh: 报告对该项目作了简明扼要的概述。

senses.en: to put something in a capsule or express it briefly

example.en: She capsuled the plan in three sentences.
example.zh: 她用三句话概括了这个计划。

senses.en: a child whose parents have died

example.en: After losing both parents, she was raised in an orphanage.
example.zh: 失去双亲后，她在孤儿院长大。

senses.en: to make a child an orphan by the death of their parents

example.en: The disease orphaned many children in the region.
example.zh: 这场疾病使该地区的许多孩子沦为孤儿。

collocations: be orphaned at a young age

senses.en: a large, strong fire that burns brightly

example.en: Firefighters battled the blaze for hours.
example.zh: 消防员与烈火搏斗了数小时。

senses.en: to burn or shine brightly and strongly

example.en: The sun blazed down on the beach.
example.zh: 烈日照耀着海滩。

senses.en: to display or announce news prominently and widely

example.en: The news was blazed across every front page.
example.zh: 这则新闻被醒目地刊登在各家报纸的头版上。

senses.en: to be the first to do something and show others how to do it

example.en: Her research blazed a trail for future scientists.
example.zh: 她的研究为后来的科学家开辟了道路。

senses.en: in a correct or accurate way

example.en: Please answer the questions correctly.
example.zh: 请正确回答这些问题。

senses.en: in a proper or appropriate manner

example.en: The equipment must be installed correctly.
example.zh: 设备必须安装得当。

senses.en: a tiny particle with a negative electric charge that moves around the nucleus of an atom

example.en: Electrons flow through the wire to create an electric current.
example.zh: 电子通过导线流动形成电流。

senses.en: completely full or crowded

example.en: The train was packed with commuters during rush hour.
example.zh: 高峰时段火车上挤满了通勤的人。

senses.en: pressed tightly together or compressed

example.en: The snow was packed hard on the path.
example.zh: 小路上的雪被压得很实。

senses.en: put into a container for transport or use later
senses.zh: 打包好的；预先装好以便携带的

example.en: She took a packed lunch to school.
example.zh: 她带了自备的午餐去学校。

senses.en: to an unusually high degree

example.en: She is an exceptionally talented musician.
example.zh: 她是一位才华格外出众的音乐家。

senses.en: having very little rain; extremely dry

example.en: Plants struggle to grow in arid regions.
example.zh: 植物在干旱地区很难生长。

senses.en: lacking interest or life

example.en: The lecture was long and arid.
example.zh: 这场讲座冗长乏味。

senses.en: providing the substances needed for health and growth

example.en: Grandma prepared a nourishing bowl of chicken soup.
example.zh: 奶奶准备了一碗营养丰富的鸡汤。

senses.en: relating to birth

example.en: Most women receive natal care before giving birth.
example.zh: 大多数女性在分娩前接受产前护理。

senses.en: the sport of sailing on water while standing on a board with an attached sail

example.en: Windsurfing is popular on this windy coast.
example.zh: 帆板运动在这个多风的海岸很受欢迎。

senses.en: producing little or no smoke

example.en: The city promotes smokeless fuels to cut air pollution.
example.zh: 该市推广无烟燃料以减少空气污染。

senses.en: not showing emotion; calm and objective

example.en: The judge remained detached during the emotional testimony.
example.zh: 在情绪激动的证词面前，法官保持超然。

senses.en: separate and not connected to anything else

example.en: They live in a detached house with a large garden.
example.zh: 他们住在一栋带大花园的独立式住宅里。

senses.en: a common white and grey seabird with long wings

example.en: Gulls circled above the fishing boats.
example.zh: 海鸥在渔船上空盘旋。

senses.en: to trick or deceive someone (dated)

example.en: They gulled the tourist into paying twice.
example.zh: 他们骗那位游客付了两次钱。

senses.en: a large group of fish swimming together

example.en: A shoal of herring appeared near the boat.
example.zh: 一群鲱鱼出现在小船附近。

senses.en: a shallow place or sandbank in water

example.en: The ship ran aground on a shoal.
example.zh: 船在浅滩上搁浅了。

senses.en: to become or make shallow

example.en: The river shoals near its mouth.
example.zh: 这条河在入海口附近变浅。

senses.en: the care of children, especially while parents work

example.en: Childcare costs have risen sharply in recent years.
example.zh: 近年来托育费用大幅上涨。

senses.en: to shine with a soft, wavering light

example.en: The lake shimmered in the morning light.
example.zh: 湖面在晨光中闪烁着微光。

senses.en: a soft, wavering light

example.en: There was a shimmer on the water at sunset.
example.zh: 日落时水面上泛着微光。

senses.en: to struggle or move clumsily, especially in water or difficulty

example.en: He floundered in the deep water, trying to stay afloat.
example.zh: 他在深水中挣扎，努力保持漂浮。

senses.en: to behave awkwardly or have serious difficulties

example.en: The company floundered after losing its biggest customer.
example.zh: 失去最大客户后，公司陷入了困境。

senses.en: a flat sea fish eaten as food

example.en: We ordered grilled flounder at the seaside restaurant.
example.zh: 我们在海边餐厅点了烤比目鱼。

senses.en: a change or result produced by something

example.en: The medicine has few side effects.
example.zh: 这种药物副作用很少。

senses.en: personal belongings (in the phrase personal effects)

example.en: After the trip, he packed up all his personal effects.
example.zh: 旅行结束后，他收拾好了全部个人物品。

senses.en: to bring about or make happen (formal)

example.en: The new manager effected several changes in the office.
example.zh: 新经理在办公室推行了几项变革。
